text:
ada: FYI - spike in ap-east1 preempt churn since 03:12UTC, lots of tiny pods being kicked to reshuffle for reserved-shot jobs.
peter: saw it too. fit_failures jumped, and scheduler logs show repeated "fit attempt -> preempt -> reschedule" loops.
lucy: rough numbers?
ada: preempt_count +28% last 90m, tail pod_start_time up ~2m for small batch jobs.
peter: cluster profile: mixing ampere and older gen GPUs w/ different memory caps. binpack heuristic tries to consolidate for big reserved workloads and ends up repeatedly moving small pods.
lucy: can we short-circuit by prioritizing warm-pools and adding a short-lived toleration to low-prio namespaces? avoids moving customer pods.
ada: agree. Quick mitigation plan: 1) scale warm-pool in ap-east1 by +30% 2) enable a canary scheduler score favoring nodes with label warmpool-ready 3) add toleration with 10m TTL to spot namespaces.
ops-bot: [runbook] id=r-7a2, owner=peter, cohort=ap-east1, duration=20m.
peter: sample commands: 
```bash
# scale warmpool
kubectl -n infra-scale scale deploy/warm-pool-ape --replicas=52 # from 40
# namespace toleration (applies to spot-batch)
kubectl -n spot-batch patch deployment --all -p '{"spec":{"template":{"spec":{"tolerations":[{"key":"gpu_frag_bias","operator":"Exists","effect":"NoSchedule","tolerationSeconds":600}]}}}}'
```
lucy: for scheduler scoring, we'll canary to 5% of schedulers via configmap group tag. keep preferWarmPoolScore=40.
ada: start warm-pool scale now. I'll watch preempt_count and fit_failures.
ops-bot: [info] warm-pool scale requested by ada. request=r-7a2-scale.
ada: warm-pool scaled to 52, tolerations patched. triggering canary config apply to 5% schedulers.
peter: initial telemetry (5m): preempt_count -9%, fit_failures -14%, pod_start_p50 -45s. Good early signal.
lucy: keep an eye on reserved job latency; we don't want to starve large reserved jobs.
ada: agree. If counters keep improving for 20m, we extend canary to 25% and keep warm-pool +20% for 2h. then revert configmap changes.
ops-bot: [metric] ap-east1 preempt_count delta=-11% (10m).
peter: filing quick follow-up RFC: adaptive_warmpool_scoring to prefer filling warm-pools before global repack attempts. I'll include failure modes and cost delta.
lucy: documented. Also let's add a safety threshold: do not prefer warm-pool if reserved-job tail latency > 2x baseline.
ada: team, thanks. we'll keep this window tight and revert on any adverse effect.
ops-bot: [alert] runbook r-7a2 active: ends in 20m."
